verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript library you install via npm and run inside your own app against your own SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL database, so the core product is inherently self-hosted. Community users independently confirm this: auth data lives in your own DB with no provider lock-in, they "own all the data," and it is called the best open-source option for TypeScript auth. missing for 10: an explicit first-party open-source license statement in the evidence, and clarity on which features one commenter describes as enterprise-only and whether those are self-hostable.
